title: The Unexpected Vow Anew
author: Felix Hartwell
blurb: Wren Coldharbour, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
